title: What If Earth Had No Greenhouse Gases? A Frozen Ball
subject: earth planet

scenes.text: What if Earth had no greenhouse gases? The planet would be a frozen ball.
Today the average surface temperature is about 15 degrees Celsius, or 59 Fahrenheit.
Without greenhouse gases, it would drop to around minus 18 Celsius, roughly zero Fahrenheit.
That's a 33 degree drop, and oceans, lakes, and rivers would freeze.
Ice reflects sunlight, which cools the planet further, a loop that can lock in a snowball state.
Photosynthesis and the food chains built on it would collapse. The same gases we worry about also keep us alive.
